cohort.eligibility: Valid DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash responses exist for every meeting under both prompts.

scoring_contract.boundary_metric: one-to-one nearest-prediction recall, any agenda item
scoring_contract.item_metric: one-to-one nearest-prediction recall, manual agenda association plus boundary

metric_definitions.chapter_assignment_coverage: One-to-one matched gold chapters assigned to the correct manual agenda item, regardless of timestamp, divided by gold chapters with manual agenda association.
metric_definitions.timing_accuracy_on_assigned_chapters: Correctly assigned gold chapters whose predicted start is within 60 seconds, divided by correctly assigned gold chapters.
metric_definitions.combined_chapter_recall: Correctly assigned gold chapters with predicted start within 60 seconds, divided by all gold chapters with manual agenda association.
